Tekion CHN._comment: 'Its rules are the same as Tekion BLR' — so this file is Tekion's block re-keyed to the Chennai site, with the names prefixed so the two counters' diagnostics stay distinguishable. ONE THING NEEDS THE CLIENT'S EYE: Tekion BLR's weekday rules are pinned to BLR's theme map (Mon = mix, Tue = chinese, Wed = north, Thu = mix, Fri = biryani) while Tekion CHN's is different (Mon/Tue = mix, Wed = south, Thu = biryani, Fri = north). Same rules therefore need the same theme map — otherwise the chinese Tuesday lands on a mix day and the Friday chicken biryani on a north day. Neither is a failure (a slot_composition count is capped to what the day can serve, so a component with nothing eligible relaxes instead of going INFEASIBLE), but the menu will not be the one the client pictured. Recommended DB change: set Tekion CHN's theme_map to Tekion BLR's. One of Tekion BLR's six references is deliberately NOT copied: `indian_veg_dry_on_chinese_day` makes the Chinese day's veg dry a regular Indian dish, and Chennai's own ruleset already exempts `veg_dry` from theme filtering entirely, so the rule would have nothing to narrow.

rules._comment: Chennai carries 13 liquid rices, so this cap and the Thursday khichdi below both have something to act on.
rules.name: tekion_chn_liquid_rice_once

rules._comment: Non-veg gravy Monday and Wednesday, chicken biryani Friday, mirroring Tekion BLR. Tuesday and Thursday are blank via tekion_chn_nonveg_mwf. Mon/Wed exclude is_egg_dish because a few egg dishes are mis-flagged is_south_chicken_gravy in the ontology.
rules.name: tekion_chn_nonveg_by_weekday

rules._comment: Chinese rice on Tuesday. Chennai carries 7 chinese fried rices and 14 chinese carbs, so the component is not inert — but see the header note about Tekion CHN's Tuesday being a `mix` day rather than a chinese one.
rules.name: tekion_chn_chinese_rice_tuesday

rules._comment: The veg-gravy half of the same Tuesday rule. Chennai has exactly ONE chinese veg gravy, so under `unique_items` this can be met on one Tuesday per cooldown window and relaxes on the others — the shortfall is reported by diagnose() rather than failing the plan. Deepening Chennai's chinese gravy pool is the real fix.
rules.name: tekion_chn_chinese_gravy_tuesday

rules._comment: Paneer gravy every Wednesday. Chennai carries 6 paneer gravies.
rules.name: tekion_chn_paneer_gravy_wednesday

rules._comment: Khichdi every Thursday. There is no is_khichdi flag; every khichdi carries is_liquid_rice, and tekion_chn_liquid_rice_once caps liquid rice at one a week, so pinning Thursday lands that one there.
rules.name: tekion_chn_khichdi_thursday
